candidate_pool: the shared public 120-candidate P6 proxy pool, filtered only by the eight registered scenario definitions
seed_schedule: 900000 + 7919 * seed_index + first_6_hex(sha1('p6_s3|' + scenario)) modulo 4096; common across methods

matched_evaluation.unit_definition: one scored initialization/offspring candidate or one evaluated local proposal; local proposals are not double-counted as population evaluations
matched_evaluation.primary_metric: standard feasible-front hypervolume under the registered empirical bounds, clipping to [0,1], and reference point (1.1,1.1,1.1,1.1)

matched_time.deadline_check: before every candidate or local-proposal evaluation; ranking may cause a small recorded overshoot
matched_time.metric_timing: front extraction and hypervolume calculation occur after the common search deadline

BiLo-NSGA.source_semantics: shared custom kernel: low-density initialization, uniform crossover, bit mutation 1/n, deterministic budget repair, first-half offspring local search, constraint non-dominated selection

NSGA-II.selection: binary tournament by constraint rank, crowding distance, then seeded random tie break
NSGA-II.host_limitation: recorded pymoo 0.6.2 is unavailable; installed pymoo 0.4.1 is used only for its pure-Python hypervolume indicator, not optimization

Pareto Local Search.implementation: stage-local budget-metered form of the disclosed multi-start add/delete/swap PLS
Pareto Local Search.repair: deterministic shared budget repair for starts

multiplicity.primary_family: 16 matched-evaluation BiLo-NSGA contrasts: 2 comparators x 8 scenarios
multiplicity.secondary_family: 16 matched-time BiLo-NSGA contrasts: 2 comparators x 8 scenarios
multiplicity.test: exact two-sided paired sign test across the 30 common seed indices; zero differences omitted

hypervolume_schemes.bounds: shared fixed seeded bounds with 5% padding
shared fixed seeded bounds with 5% padding
reported bounds expanded by 25% of their padded span on both sides

local_sensitivity.design: one factor at a time around the registered BiLo-NSGA local rule

source_contract.policy: read shared source and inputs only; write all new artifacts under this stage directory; regress P5 hashes and the shared Mintou test suite
